originality.rationale: Comparison of the exact two-parameter pair-class metric statement against general ℓ1 cut-metric theorems, same-graph enumerations, exact older negative-type results, and database neighbors did not identify an implication yielding the exact distortion staircase plus optimizer support. Matoušek (1996) could not be inspected beyond abstract and constitutes an explicit historical priority risk, not a claimed negative whole-text inspection.
residual_risks: Full Matoušek (1996) text was inaccessible; a dimension-independent exact ℓ1 crown theorem cannot be ruled out from the abstract alone.
Older literature under bipartite double-cover, bipartite Kneser, metric cut cone or metric embedding aliases may contain equivalent formulas; no claim of exhaustiveness is made.
Database record summaries were used only as summaries; they cannot establish whole-document noncoverage.

The exact invariant matters for finite graph cut cones and metric embedding sharpness; it is not an ad hoc parameter slice.
